parent_objective: mine and robustness-gate a source-diverse current-base wrong-history boundary surface after short-PPO promotion
blocked_by: current public-gate base was promoted from known public surfaces; refreshed source-diverse current-base surface is needed before medium PPO
invalidates: running medium PPO before current-base surface refresh

public_gates: M1055 must not train or run PPO
M1055 must mine matched-current ambiguity for the three 4096-step family checkpoints

M1055 must classify sparse or duplicate-dominated surfaces instead of loosening thresholds
M1055 must not promote a checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not loosen source-diversity thresholds after seeing failure
do not route to medium PPO directly from M1055

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs current-base source-diverse surface refresh for the short-PPO promoted family
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public proof surface refresh only; no training, no PPO, no promotion
stop_condition: stop if accepted wrong-history rows are below threshold
stop if wrong-history outcome sensitivity is absent
stop if actor input contract changes
fallback_plan: if pass, route to compact corpus/objective conversion design
if sparse, route to sampling retarget design
if duplicate-dominated, route to public-overfit audit
if wrong-history-insensitive, route to self-ID proof audit

hypothesis: The newly promoted 4096-step public-gate base family still exposes a source-diverse wrong-history outcome boundary surface suitable for conversion into replay/objective corpora.
